message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round. | | **Players** | 2–10. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”), plus 4 “Wild” and 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck. Deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile. Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, follow the special rule (e.g., if it’s a Wild, the dealer chooses the color). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card from your hand that matches either the color or the value of the top card on the discard pile. You may also play a Wild or Wild Draw Four card at any time. | | **Special Cards** | • **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Same as Wild, but next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have only one card left, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player calls you out before the next player plays, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards remaining in opponents’ hands: numbered cards count as face value, Draw Two/Skip/Reverse = 20 points each, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | **Optional Variations** - **Stacking**: Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing immediately. - **No Wild Draw Four Challenge**: Some groups play without the challenge rule. - **Custom Decks**: Use themed decks or add extra special cards. That’s the core of Uno! Enjoy playing.
